title: Single-dose injection and ablation checks per direction
model_config: blank prompt, interestingness task; conditions: no_inject, inject_neg2 (alpha = -2), inject_pos2 (alpha = +2), ablate (direction projected out)

feature_labels.gender: Gender (female minus male, averaged over emotions)
feature_labels.country_nigeria: Country (Nigeria-extended vs base, averaged over personas)

aggregation: mean and std over images, as saved; per-emotion rows come from a summary table that stores means only (std and n not saved there)
caveats: The no_inject baseline covers more images than the injected conditions (see n_images), so differences to it are not paired.
Differences between conditions are small relative to the score std.
